snippet.title: 👧 Gretel & Hansel Storybook Trailer – Play Part One Demo Now! 👦
snippet.description:
🕷️ Play the Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4111940/Gretel__Hansel_Demo/?utm_source=gretel_youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=storybook_trailer

Gretel & Hansel is a hand-painted exploration adventure built from hundreds of physical watercolor paintings. Abandoned in a cursed forest, you play as Gretel as you guide her brother home—outwitting deadly traps, unraveling sinister puzzles, and escaping the clutches of a ravenous witch.

Originally released in 2009–2010, Gretel & Hansel Part 1 & Part 2 were played over 4.7 million times and reached #1 on Newgrounds. Fifteen years later, the fairytale returns—completely reimagined, fully hand-painted, and expanded with new secrets, new deaths, and an all-new Part 3.

The Part One Demo is available now on Steam.

🕷️ Wishlist the Full Game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3299820/Gretel__Hansel/?utm_source=gretel_youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=storybook_trailer
